target_customer: Hotels and event venues, starting with operators unhappy with their PMS
problem: Hotels run on legacy software and a fragmented stack of PMS, POS and booking tools. Zaplar replaces them with one AI-native system that handles operations with staff approval.
business_model: B2B SaaS with custom proposal pricing and forward-deployed engineers for onboarding
product_category: Hospitality software, AI-native PMS and hotel operating system

founders.name: Douglas Solberg
founders.background_notes: Comes from a family that has run hotels for generations, per YC page.

founders.name: Axel Andersson Lingbert
prior_employers: Consulting for banks and debt collection companies
education: MSc engineering mathematics, Lund Faculty of Engineering (LTH), dropped out

founders.name: Oscar Karlstromer
prior_employers: APAC B2B sales in Sydney and Singapore
education: Stockholm School of Economics, honors list, dropped out
previous_startups: Nordics largest non-profit for middle school academic competitions (about 40k students)

founders.name: Jon Milles
prior_employers: Largest cybersecurity firm in the Nordics (security software engineer at 17)
education: MSc computer science, Lund Technical University (LTH), dropped out
founders.background_notes: Part of first LTH Formula Student team to achieve autonomous driving, per YC page.

competitors.name: Mews
competitors.what: Hospitality PMS and platform repositioning as an AI-native operating system for hospitality

competitors.name: Apaleo
competitors.what: Open PMS platform that launched an AI Copilot for hotel operations

competitors.name: Stayntouch
competitors.what: Cloud PMS with embedded AI guest messaging
competitors.traction_then: claims to automate 95% of guest requests (vendor claim)

competitors.name: Aiva
competitors.what: AI agents coordinating hotel departments, guest experience and ancillary revenue

technical_complexity.rationale: Replacing PMS, POS, booking engine and payments in one product requires deep integrations, reliability and compliance work, plus autonomous agent behavior; hard for a seven person team.

defensibility.rationale: A PMS is deeply embedded in daily hotel operations so switching costs are high once adopted, but the same wedge is being pursued by well-funded incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents launched AI copilots and an AI-native OS in the first half of 2026, so the wedge was already contested.

market_need_then: Fragmented hotel tech stack; Zaplar cites 400+ hours per manager per year lost to tool switching and up to 19% of operating costs lost to duplicated admin (company claims). Founder Douglas Solberg comes from a hotelier family.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and operational, speaks to hotel operators about wasted hours and revenue

branding.community_and_virality: No brand press found beyond YC launch coverage.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name with exact .com, but no brand evidence yet beyond launch posts.

outcome_analysis: Zaplar joined YC in Summer 2026 from Stockholm with a team of seven and a pre-seed from Swedish investors, so there is no outcome yet. The founding team combines hotel family experience, engineering and sales. The main risk is that Mews, Apaleo and other incumbents are already shipping AI-native features, while the upside is a replace-the-stack wedge with strong switching costs once adopted.
notes: Pre-seed of about 3 million SEK led by Nyman Holding, reported by an aggregator profile site (yespress) as about $320K; PitchBook and CB Insights give total funding about $820K which includes the YC deal. Dealroom lists a conflicting $125k seed. The YC standard deal is not recorded as a round. The round amount comes from secondary sources, not the company. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs.
